upstream.revisionPolicy: Qualification is pinned to this exact observed commit; moving main requires deliberate re-observation.

materialChanges: First-party Hugging Face infrastructure for reproducible Harbor benchmark execution on Hugging Face infrastructure.

Current exact head adds pinned QEMU-fixed diagnostic presets and held-50 diagnostic preset publication, making environment reproducibility and failure isolation directly relevant to SZL evaluation governance.
Provides an evaluation-infrastructure lane distinct from model, inference, retrieval, agent-memory, and kernel admissions already represented in the Frontier catalog.

acceptance: Use only fixed public/non-secret benchmark fixtures for the first evaluation.
Record exact upstream commit, environment image/preset identity, benchmark input digest and output receipt.
Prove rerun determinism or explicitly quantify nondeterminism under the same pinned environment.
Fail closed when required QEMU/runtime/backend capability is unavailable; UNAVAILABLE is valid evidence and must not be converted to PASS.
Do not grant deployment, merge, secret, provider-write or production-route authority to the benchmark runner.
Compare Harbor execution receipts against the existing SZL Forge harness contract before proposing adoption.

alignment.claimBoundary: This intake evaluates reproducibility infrastructure only and does not assert model quality, production readiness, or authority-chain convergence.
